title: Full retail contestability for small electricity customers (Tasmania)
summary: Tasmania opened retail electricity to competition for small businesses in 2011 and for all small customers from 1 July 2014.

instruments.title: Tasmanian electricity retail competition arrangements (instruments not checked)

commenced.what: All small customers able to choose a retailer

direction_rationale: Opening households to retailer choice allows entry by new retailers.

assessment.summary: Ended the incumbent retailer's exclusive right to supply small electricity customers, so every customer could choose a retailer. In Tasmania few retailers entered, because the market is small and prices stayed regulated.

marks.reason: Removes the incumbent's exclusive right to small customers, opening the market to new retailers.
Customers can switch retailer, so retailers must compete for them.

responsible.note: Administers the Electricity Supply Industry Act 1995 (in part).
